ModMetaData.name: Colonists' Deco (Continued)
ModMetaData.author: Abe Vriens
ModMetaData.description:
[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/Info.png[/img] Update of Abe Vrienss mod https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2558083020
[b]The release of RimWorld 1.6 added improved support for [url=https://github.com/emipa606/AssetBuilder/blob/main/README.md]Asset Bundles[/url][/b]. To avoid doubling the size of the mod, it was re-released using only Asset Bundles, you can find the previous version of this mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2894674825]here[/url].
- Should support more end-tables, as long as they dont already have a lamp on them

[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/OriginalDescription.png[/img] [img]https://img.litet.net/XNDcVTT.png[/img]
[img]https://img.litet.net/28eFc45.png[/img] - Colonists will decorate their bedroom with all kinds of decorations. Doing this levels up their construction skill. - Decoration levels can be researched, each research reflects a different tech level.
[img]https://img.litet.net/6QOB71B.png[/img] - Add room specific decorations - Add customisable decorations [strike]- Add random poster images[/strike] [strike]- Add more placeable items[/strike] [strike]- Add UI button to preview decoration in full size[/strike]
[img]https://img.litet.net/D7Ig9n1.png[/img]
[img]https://img.litet.net/06Ybo2O.gif[/img]
[img]https://img.litet.net/Dbfd3PI.png[/img] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=867467808&searchtext=camera%2B]Camera+[/url] is recommended if you want to see the decorations in detail.
Feel free to contact me if you have any problems with the mod.
Current version - [V2.4.0]
[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/ReportingIssues.png[/img] [list] [*] See if the the error persists if you just have this mod and its requirements active. [*] If not, try adding your other mods until it happens again. [*] Always post your log using the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2873415404]Log Uploader[/url] [*] For best support, please use the Discord-channel for error-reporting. [*] Do not report errors by making a discussion-thread, I get no notification of that. [*] If you have the solution for a problem, please post it to the GitHub repository. [*] Use [url=https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/releases/latest]RimSort[/url] to sort your mods [/list]
